metadata.name: Red Forty
metadata.author: Pedaleira
metadata.summary: A classic-voiced high gain preamp with a big low end (a 12AX7 input stage, a gain pot, three cascaded gain stages, a treble-middle-bass tone stack) into a push-pull EL34 power amp with a strong resonance (depth) control. The topology and the starting values are those of the High Gain description; the gain law, the levels, the clipping points, the tone stack and the feedback network were then fitted to measurements of a reference amp (its GAIN sweep, its line-level responses and its tone, presence and resonance sweeps). Every value the fit moved is marked "fitted" with what it was fitted to.
references: D. T. Yeh and J. O. Smith, Discretization of the '59 Fender Bassman Tone Stack, DAFx-06, 2006
J. Pakarinen and D. T. Yeh, A review of digital techniques for modeling vacuum-tube guitar amplifiers, Computer Music Journal 33(2), 2009
Pedaleira measurements of a reference amp played through a modelling unit's USB input: GAIN sweeps with a 1 kHz staircase, THD at -54 dBFS, the test signal's sweeps at -18 dBFS (2026)
